div.div:
SES rewrites the Message-ID.
The header the recipient sees is not the one
we mint, so the id returned by SendRawEmail
is stored as external_message_id — and
inbound In-Reply-To / References are matched
against either id. Without it, replies chain
against an id that never left the building.

div.div:
What makes ingest safe to repeat.
Per-folder UID cursors (reset on a UIDVALIDITY change) and
UNIQUE(user_id, message_id) — not the folder move. Raw MIME
is written before the row; only Import is moved, and only after
its row commits. Mail that continues no thread, is from no
tracked contact and was not imported is ignored, never stored.
Exactly one environment polls the mailbox.
